subject: CareMatic pilot: opsheet for streaming + toolcall + structured-output alignment
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carematic.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 13:05 PDT
Subject: Pilot inquiry — streaming + toolcall + structured outputs

Hi Marcus / team,

Thanks again for the intro call today. CareMatic is excited to run a short pilot to validate live transcription + structured downstream events using Redwood’s streaming + toolcall stack. High-level asks from our side:
- Low-latency streaming for triage transcripts (sub-second token commits)
- Function/tool calling to trigger our triage workflow (create case, assign severity)
- Structured JSON output that maps to our Case API (we can share schema)

Could you put together an opsheet that outlines: scope, data flow, deliverables (schema + tests), and a proposed 3-week timeline? We have legal and security folks that will want an artifact for SOC 2 inputs, but initial focus is ops + acceptance criteria.

Thanks — available for a short call Tue/Wed next week.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, CareMatic Health
liam.oconnor@carematic.com

Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — streaming + toolcall + structured outputs

Hi Liam — great to connect yesterday, really appreciate the clear problem statement. I put together a concise opsheet (attached) that covers scope, roles, and a proposed cadence. Key highlights:

- Pilot scope: streaming transcription -> toolcall to CareMatic Case API -> structured JSON output with 95% field coverage for triage.
- Duration: 3 weeks (1 discovery, 1 integration sprint, 1 validation + acceptance).
- Deliverables: connection guide, schema template, test prompt set, and runbook for failover (model fallback policy).

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical kickoff on Wed 2027-04-28 11:00 PDT. I'll have Monica (CS) drive the MAP and Jordan will own commercial-checkpoints.

Attached: pilot_ops_overview.pdf (opsheet)

If that time doesn't work, suggest two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carematic.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26 11:30 PDT
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — Pilot mutual action plan + schema template

Hi Liam — looping in a short mutual action plan (MAP) below so everyone has the acceptance criteria up front. I also attached a starter schema-template.json that your backend team can adapt.

Mutual Action Plan (abridged) — CareMatic pilot
1) Discovery (3 days)
  - RW: share pilot_ops_overview.pdf and schema-template.json (done)
  - CM: share current Case API OpenAPI snippet and sample transcripts (anonymized)
  - Outcome: mapped fields and initial mapping doc

2) Integration sprint (8 days)
  - RW: implement streaming endpoint + toolcall harness, supply sample prompts and structured-output examples
  - CM: provide test environment credentials, implement case-creation endpoint for toolcall, and validate mapping
  - Outcome: end-to-end test harness passing smoke tests

3) Validation & acceptance (5 days)
  - RW & CM: run the test prompt set (50 cases), measure mapping coverage and structured-output fidelity (schema conformance)
  - Acceptance: >=90% schema conformance OR documented deviations + remediation plan

Tech/acceptance details (high level)
- Streaming SLA target: median token commit <= 600 ms in staged environment under representative load.
- Toolcall contract: POST /cases v1 — JSON payload must match schema-template.json; retry semantics: 3x, exponential backoff.
- Structured output: Response must be valid JSON; Redwood will run schema validation and surface diffs in the console.

Attachments: schema-template.json, mutual-action-plan.csv

Open questions for CareMatic:
- Do you have a preferred JSON schema version (draft-07 vs draft-2020-12)?
- Any PII redaction requirements beyond what you sent earlier?

I can own MAP updates and acceptance run coordination. Jordan — we should confirm trial pricing and whether CareMatic needs an NDAs/PO prior to starting.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
[Attachment: schema-template.json (JSON, 6 KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carematic.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27 08:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — Pilot mutual action plan + schema template

Monica, Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. Answers inline:

> Do you have a preferred JSON schema version?
We are currently on draft-07 across our platform, so draft-07 would be easiest for validation on our side.

> Any PII redaction requirements?
We can supply anonymized transcripts for the pilot. Long term we'll need a PII redaction plan — happy to capture that as a separate compliance artifact.

Regarding timeline: Wed 4/28 11:00 PDT works for the kickoff. I'll bring our lead engineer (Priya Shah) and security lead (Markus Berg). For the test harness, we'll provide a staging endpoint and a Postman collection by EOD Monday (4/26) — should that be fine?

One operational ask: can Redwood run a lightweight schema conformance check in CI so we can get immediate failure feedback when outputs diverge? If that's something Redwood can surface in the console, it would be great.

—Liam
